generator: tools/fx/gen_chief_fx.py (procedural numpy + Pillow on fxlib; fx / ui house style)

conventions.contract: CONTRACT_V42 §AG. Paths relative to frost-village/assets/. Fragment name: chief_fx (the build packs it with ui5_icons into the v42_core page).
conventions.frames: Atlas frames are named {key}_{i} (nav_chevron_{ii}); trimmed JSON-hash with sourceSize kept, so anchors refer to the full contract frame. sprites[key]: frame (first), anchor, frameSize, frames, frameNames, fps, repeat; animated keys also carry anims.play, so Assets.spriteAnims creates 'spr:<key>:play' (e.g. sprite.play('spr:chief_halo:play')).
conventions.readability: Every bright shape has a darker cool (teal / navy) or amber rim and the nav pieces a soft navy contact shadow, so they read on white snow, grey cobbles, brown dirt and under the night MULTIPLY overlay (darkness 0.45, #5A6AA8). Drawn on a 4x supersampled canvas, clean from 0.5x to 2x.

screenSize.chief_halo: drawn 45 CSS px wide on a 390 px phone at every zoom: world width = aura.ringPx 70 x min(2, 1.2 / zoom) (zoom < aura.fullZoom 1.2, else 70); setScale(width / 192). CSS px per world px = zoom x 390 / 720.
screenSize.chief_marker: drawn 22 CSS px wide: setScale(22 / (zoom x 390 / 720) / 72), 14 px above the head or the top of the carried stack.
screenSize.nav: nav_chevron / nav_dot / nav_ring at world scale 1 (0.8 next to the tutorial arrow); nav_badge scale 1 in the world; nav_edge in the UI scene at scale 0.75-1.

conventions.depth: ring + rank band DEPTH.PAD + 2 (band - 0.01), glow chief - 0.5, sparkles chief +- 1, marker DEPTH.LABEL - 30; nav chevron / dots / ring DEPTH.PAD + 3, badge DEPTH.LABEL - 40.

chief_halo.notes: Aurora ring on the ground under the chief (DEPTH.PAD + 2: over pads and decals, under shadows and every character). Hollow 2:1 jelly tube, outer 184 x 92, ring 7 px; mint -> sky -> lilac gradient travels once round per loop; 1 px gold inner line, 1 px darker teal outer rim (snow), soft glow; 6 tiny stars twinkle on it. Centre fully transparent. World width = aura.ringPx 70 x min(2, 1.2 / zoom) for zoom < 1.2 (else 70) -> setScale(width / 192): ~45 CSS px on a 390 px phone at every zoom.

chief_halo_gold.notes: The working state (chief at a station work spot, labour.chiefSpeed x1.25 made visible): same ellipse in warm gold, brighter glow, a sunburst of 12 short rays inside the ring pointing out at it (frames 0-3 grow, 4-7 settle). Same scale / position as chief_halo; crossfade.

chief_halo_rank2.notes: From 읍 on: thin double gold band (2 px + 1 px, 4 px apart), outer 208 x 104, drawn just under the ring (depth ring - 0.01) at the ring scale x 192 / 192 (it already sits 12 px outside the 184 px ring in its own 216 px frame: use the SAME scale as the ring).

chief_glow_back.notes: 광채: soft vertical oval radiance behind the body (depth = chief - 0.5), anchor = his feet. Pale gold core #FFE7A3 55 % fading to mint (left) / lilac (right) at 0 %, slow shimmer, no hard edge. Drawn 1:1 it spans ~1.4 x the 128 px chief frame. Alpha aura.glowDay 0.35 by day, aura.glowNight 0.6 at night.

chief_sparkle.notes: One mote twinkle (appears, peaks on frames 1-2, fades): <= 6 pooled, riding the ring (depth chief +- 1) at setScale(ring scale x (0.45 .. 0.75)), and the x1.25 / 응원 sparkles at scale ~1.

chief_marker.notes: Far-zoom / crowd / 관망 star pin over his head (or his carried tower), DEPTH.LABEL - 30 (above the night overlay). Anchor = pointer tip. Draw 22 CSS px wide: world scale = 22 / (zoom x 390 / 720) / 72. Star 32 px across in the frame (>= 30). 4-frame light sweep at 6 fps, no bob.

nav_chevron.notes: Flat ground chevron (double >) lying on the 2:1 ground, pre-projected like a decal. Frame k = nav_chevron_{k:02d} points along SCREEN angle k x 22.5 deg (0 = screen right, clockwise): k = round(atan2(dy, dx) / 22.5 deg) mod 16 for the screen vector to the next route point. DEPTH.PAD + 3, 56 px ahead of his boots, scale 1 (0.8 when the tutorial arrow also shows).

nav_dot.notes: Footprint dot along the route every nav.dotEvery 48 px: nav_dot_0 normal, nav_dot_1 highlight for the light wave running toward the target every 1.2 s. DEPTH.PAD + 3.

nav_ring.notes: Destination ring on the pad (DEPTH.PAD + 3): 12 teal capsule dashes with gold cores pulsing outward and fading (frame 0 small / bright -> 7 large / faint), dashes creep 1/12 turn per loop. Play the anim at scale 1 (drop the code pulse).

nav_badge.notes: Badge 90 px above the destination ring (DEPTH.LABEL - 40). Anchor = pointer tip. Draw the item icon into iconRect [x, y, w, h] (a 56 px cream disc; icon ~44 px), the short name as text beside or under it.

nav_edge.notes: Screen-edge badge (UI scene): rotate it so its RIGHT-side notch points at the off-screen target (rotation = atan2(dy, dx)); keep the icon upright (draw the icon as a separate image at the badge centre, iconRect [x, y, w, h] = 44 px disc) and the route metres under it.
